text: Oh? Welcome.\c\nIs there anything you’d like to know about?
Is there anything else you’d like to know about?

Here at the Pokémon Nursery, we take care of
the Pokémon that Trainers leave with us.\c
The Pokémon we look after won’t get strong,
but if you leave two Pokémon with us, we
sometimes find Pokémon Eggs.\c
If you want to leave your Pokémon with us,
please speak to my granddaughter outside.

If you put a Pokémon Egg in your party and carry
it around, a Pokémon will hatch from the Egg.\c
Nobody knows where Pokémon Eggs come from.
They truly are mysterious...

If you want to find Pokémon Eggs, think about
the two Pokémon you leave here.\c
I recommend you leave two of the same species
of Pokémon with different genders.\c
If the species are similar, we may still find a
Pokémon Egg.\c
But it seems we never find Eggs with certain
combinations of Pokémon left here.
Tell me about the Pokémon Nursery
Tell me about what Pokémon I should leave
